scope: Leg-KILO Go2 input association; no camera or factory world-pose fusion
fixes: Retain first LowState per identical raw IMU key; do not erase after one SportState consumption. Firmware repeats IMU keys, sometimes with different joint fields.
Increase existing pending SportState bound from 8 to 512 to accommodate delayed LowState delivery in recorded data.
Process earliest match; retain timestamped body IMU for preceding unmatched packets and overflow. Missing encoders produce no foot velocity observation and do not update contact hysteresis.
timing_limit: Identical IMU keys are an association heuristic, not proof of atomic IMU/joint acquisition. Measured 389.477073 ms is LowState minus SportState bag receipt time, not Wi-Fi end-to-end latency.

first_circle_reproducibility.old_bug_evidence: 1913 identical clouds, four frames with different accepted kinematics; five missing IMU/kinematics packets in one run. Identical Sport IMUs could select different encoder fields. Earlier 0.039 m return is not a validated accuracy result.

two_walks.method: Distance between median saved backend positions in stationary windows, seconds relative to first pose; no external ground-truth trajectory.
two_walks.limitation: Last six source frames (~0.39 s of final stationary tail) are absent: no later match flushes pending Sport packets at end of recording. Shutdown tail draining remains unresolved.
two_walks.limitation_full_rate_comparison: Full long-record 1x replay has not been repeated; rate equality is established for the short circle and the problematic long-record prefix.

jetson_live_smoke.limitation: Stationary smoke, not a new walking accuracy validation. No new CPU/RAM or network benchmark was performed.

audit: Set GO2_LEGKILO_INPUT_TRACE inside backend environment for optional CSV plus .pairing reception trace; disabled by default. Compare finalized CSVs using ws/scripts/compare-legkilo-inputs.py.
remaining: Walking validation on installed Jetson build; residual drift and map consistency; provisional contact thresholds and joint/IMU timing; recording-tail flush. Replay return discrepancy is not whole-map accuracy or a new SLAM algorithm.
